title: Control: deposit now, rest later
transcript:
Rosa Delgado (owner): The roof is $1,200 all in?
Ray Kim (Kim Roofing): $1,200. Usually half up front.
Rosa Delgado (owner): I'll pay Kim Roofing $600 now and the rest when it's done.
Ray Kim (Kim Roofing): Works for me.
note: The later balance has no date or amount said as a payment, so only the $600 is in the key.
